findings.statement: CA9 ranks 1 in the convergence ranking (score 4.5197). In tumor, RCC cells hold 0.976 of its transcripts (54.7% of RCC cells express it, cpm_share 0.958), so the signal is tumor-intrinsic.

Paired by donor, CA9 is higher in tumor cells than in proximal tubule (log2FC 7.739, padj 0.0189, 6 donors). The bulk signal survives extrapolation to purity 1 (RNA log2FC 7.787, SE 0.579) and replicates in TCGA (log2FC 9.712).

In Visium, high-CA9 spots are surrounded by RCC (log2 enrichment 0.381, padj 0.0017) and slightly by macrophages (0.099). In situ, RCC carries a composition-corrected share of 0.999 of CA9 transcripts.

The best CA9 glue site scores 0.546 (pLDDT 90.3, volume 126.8 A3, 1 accessible lysine); the model mean pLDDT is 76.56. Ligand-site recall is 0.5, but recall in the top pockets is only 0.221, so this is a weak, small site. No glue is implied.

KDR is an endothelial gene. Endothelial cells hold 0.951 of tumor transcripts (40.5% expressing, cpm_share 0.979). In Visium, endothelium accounts for a composition-corrected share of 0.99. It is a microenvironment target, not a tumor-cell target.

KDR has the second-highest glue site score in the ranking (0.841). The site has pLDDT 83.1, volume 361.1 A3, depth 7.47 A and 7 accessible lysines. The model mean pLDDT is 71.12, and ligand-site recall is 0.4 (0.2 in the top pockets). This is a site hypothesis for an endothelial target; no glue is claimed.

EPAS1 transcripts sit mainly in non-tumor cells. Endothelial cells hold a 0.365 share (81.3% expressing) and RCC cells only 0.051 (4.9% expressing). The bulk RNA log2FC at purity 1 is 0.46 (SE 0.331), so the RNA signal is not clearly tumor-intrinsic.

MET is held by tumor cells, with a 0.935 transcript share in RCC (35.2% expressing, cpm_share 0.682). Endothelium has a cpm_share of 0.283. Tumor cells are above proximal tubule (log2FC 5.237) but padj is 0.069, so this is only suggestive.
CXCR4 is held by lymphocytes. CD8 T cells hold a 0.563 transcript share (72.9% expressing) and CD4 T cells 0.176 (87.8% expressing). It is an immune microenvironment gene.

CD70 ranks 3 in the convergence ranking (score 4.2143). Its tumor-up signal is tumor-intrinsic: TCGA log2FC 7.09 and RNA log2FC 4.278 at purity 1 (SE 0.724). Clinical antibody and ADC programs exist, up to phase 2.
NNMT ranks 7 in the convergence ranking. It is tumor-intrinsic (RNA log2FC at purity 1 is 5.256, SE 0.617) and has adverse prognosis (TCGA Cox log HR 0.301). It has no clinical drug in the graph.

COL23A1 is the top tumor-track candidate (novelty 0.767). RCC cells hold 0.881 of its tumor transcripts, and it has 7 ccRCC papers and no clinical drug. It is up in TCGA (log2FC 5.829) and robust to purity (log2FC 4.88 at purity 1). Heart muscle is its highest vital-organ expression (nTPM 3). Caveat: DepMap mean effect is 0.167 with no selective dependency, so there is no functional evidence.

COL23A1 is a poor glue candidate. Its model mean pLDDT is 58.91, and the single pocket scores 0.2342 with volume 8.0 A3 and pLDDT 52.9. Ligand-site validation was not run. Antibody tractability is the more plausible modality.

RAB42 is the second tumor-track candidate (novelty 0.705). RCC cells hold 0.627 of its transcripts. It has 2 ccRCC papers (20 total) and no clinical drug, and lung is its top vital-organ tissue (nTPM 2.6). It is up in TCGA (log2FC 4.371) and purity-robust (3.189 at purity 1). Caveat: no dependency evidence, and literature is counted by gene symbol.

OLFML2A is a stroma-track candidate carried by fibroblasts (0.647 of tumor transcripts). It has 2 ccRCC papers and no clinical drug. It replicates in TCGA (log2FC 2.372) and is purity-robust (1.527 at purity 1). Colon expression is notable (nTPM 27.9), which is an off-tumor risk. Caveat: it is a hypothesis with no functional evidence.

JAG2 is a stroma-track candidate carried by endothelium (0.487 of tumor transcripts). It has 9 ccRCC papers, no clinical drug and antibody tractability. It is up in TCGA (log2FC 1.549) and purity-robust (1.061 at purity 1). The TCGA Cox log HR is -0.177. Caveat: the endothelial share is under half, and there is no functional evidence.

GAL3ST4 is the top immune-track candidate (novelty 0.64). Macrophages hold 0.972 of its transcripts. It has 1 ccRCC paper and no clinical drug, and is purity-robust (log2FC 0.401 at purity 1). It is up in TCGA (log2FC 2.993) with adverse prognosis (Cox log HR 0.177). Caveat: the effect is modest and there is no functional evidence.

GAL3ST4 has a credible glue site on paper. The score is 0.7874 (pLDDT 92.8, 5 accessible lysines), but the volume is 819.7 A3 and the model mean pLDDT is 79.31. Ligand-site validation was not run, so this is a macrophage-targeted site hypothesis only.

LILRB4 is a macrophage gene (0.933 of tumor transcripts) with 7 ccRCC papers. Its tumor-up signal is infiltration-driven: TCGA log2FC is 3.7 but log2FC at purity 1 is only 0.508, so it is flagged as not purity-robust.

caveats: Candidates in the discovery screen are data-ranked hypotheses: no dependency or functional evidence, and literature is counted by gene symbol.
Visium enrichment is abundance-weighted and effect sizes are small (log2 enrichment 0.04 to 0.4).
Glue site scores rank sites, not degraders. Several sites are small (8 to 127 A3) or lack ligand-site validation, and no glue is implied.
Some celltype_expression groups have few cells or donors (PT 39 cells, Epi_other 18 cells), and single-donor tumor-vs-proximal-tubule contrasts have limited power.
The CD70 single-cell values had no evidence id, so only convergence and bulk values are quoted for it.
Statements about EPAS1 and MET reflect RNA only. EPAS1 protein log2FC at purity 1 is positive (2.367), unlike its RNA.
